news_articles.snippet: Professional networking platform LinkedIn has announced that it is testing a new Collaborative Posts feature that will allow multiple members and LinkedIn Pages to publish content together on the platform.

news_articles.snippet: LinkedIn has appointed Judy Ong as senior communications manager, APAC, with Ong relocating into the platform's regional communications ranks after nearly four years at Disney.

news_articles.title: LinkedIn expands Brand Kit to give marketers control over ai-generated content.
news_articles.snippet: LinkedIn has continued quietly developing its Brand Kit feature inside Campaign Manager, giving marketers a way to set their core brand colors, fonts, and brand voice guidelines that LinkedIn's AI system then uses when generating ads and content automatically.

news_articles.title: LinkedIn adds audience reach breakdown to creator analytics.
news_articles.snippet: LinkedIn has introduced a new analytics metric that allows creators to see how much of their content reach comes from people within their network compared with those outside it, according to a post by Sam Carrao Clanon, Direcotr od Product, Creator, LinkedIn.

news_articles.title: LinkedIn adds new post analytics to help creators measure real business impact.
news_articles.snippet: LinkedIn has rolled out expanded post analytics that give creators a clearer picture of exactly who their content is reaching, splitting impressions into two distinct categories: in-network reach and out-of-network reach.
